html:
Roman emperor from 69 to 79 CE, who won the civil war of the Year of the Four Emperors and founded the Flavian dynasty.

He came from a family of the equestrian class in the Sabine country, not the old nobility. He made his name commanding a legion in the conquest of Britain. In 67 CE Nero sent him to put down the great Jewish revolt in Judaea (the First Jewish-Roman War). After Nero's death, in July 69 CE, the armies of Egypt and the east proclaimed him emperor, and his supporters took Rome that December. His son Titus finished the Judaean war and in 70 CE destroyed the Temple in Jerusalem.

Vespasian found the treasury empty and refilled it with new taxes, including one on public urinals. When Titus objected, he is said to have held a coin to his nose and said "money does not smell". He began the Colosseum on the site of Nero's palace lake. Dying in 79 CE, he joked, "I think I am becoming a god." His sons Titus and Domitian ruled after him.
sum: Roman emperor from 69 to 79 CE, who won the civil war of the Year of the Four Emperors and founded the Flavian dynasty.
